content.title: Urban Outfitters Stock Sees RS Rating Dresses Up For Holidays
content.summary: One important metric to look for in a stock is an 80 or higher Relative Strength Rating.  Urban Outfitters stock now clears that threshold, with a jump from 80 to 85 Friday.  The retail stock soared after posting record Q3 earning results, amid revenue growth of 12% to $1.5 billion and a diversified strategy.

content.title: Retail Stocks Move Cautiously Higher. Beware the ‘Silly Season.’
content.summary: Retail stocks were on track to post modest gains in Friday’s holiday-shortened trading session.  The SPDR S&P Retail ETF, also known by its ticker, XRT, was up 0.2%, compared with the S&P 500’s 0.3% gain.  Walmart stock was up 0.8%, Costco Wholesale gained 0.5%, and Target rose 1.5%.
